Overview

AO Law Office provides representation and guidance in a wide range of family law matters, including desk divorces, property division, child support, and alternative dispute resolution. Our services are delivered on a flat-fee basis, offering transparency and affordable solutions tailored to your family’s needs. The following services are available on a flat- fee basis.

Services and Pricing
